name: Semiotic
long_description:
Semiotic builds AI design agents. We’re starting with agents that build landing pages for fast‑growing startups. 

Existing AI website builders didn't make creating websites easier—they made creating ugly websites easier. So, companies choose between blue-purple gradient slop or agencies with 3-month waitlists and $100k minimums.

You don't have to choose anymore. 

Start a project: semiotic.com

launches.title: Semiotic: AI Design Firm
launches.tagline: Landing pages for SF's fastest growing startups.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’ll design your company’s landing page better and faster than any design agency in your LinkedIn inbox right now.\
\
We’re building an AI design firm to out-think, out-design, and out-produce human design teams. In just 4 weeks since launch, we’ve generated $78,000 in revenue.\
\
https://youtu.be/edCfH_UGLC0

Most design teams are inefficient at nearly every step of the process—onboarding, research, execution, handoff—all still done manually because it’s “the right way,” (i.e.) the old way.

I (Michael) know this because I ran a (human) design studio for four years, from late high school through my sophomore year in college, and interned at one of the world’s largest design agencies.

My cofounders and I previously spent six months building design tools and talking to over 300 designers—from freelancers to global firms—only to find out that most of these **inefficiencies are so deeply entrenched that selling software wasn’t an option.**

The only solution is to rebuild the design firm itself.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95149&key=user_uploads/1797226/fbf846ab-8752-4fe4-b06d-f05fbc2c3bc6)

\
\
**ASK:**

If you’re looking for a new landing page, **scroll through our [portfolio](http://www.semiotic.so/).** If a friend of yours needs a website, [send them our way](https://cal.com/team/semiotic/30min)!
